tips.down1_pct: Octave -1: one octave below. Single notes only: a chord has no single octave.
tips.up_pct: Octave +1: one octave above, clearest high on the neck with the neck pickup.
tips.fuzz_pct: Fuzz: pushes the octave above. No effect while Octave +1 is at 0.
tips.tono_pct: Tone: from round to buzzing, for all the octaves.
tips.limpio_pct: Clean: the sound of the guitar beside the octaves.

swell.name: Swell
swell.icon: <path d="M20 5 4 12l16 7" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

tips.ataque_ms: Attack: how long a note takes to grow.
tips.sens_pct: Sensitivity: how soft a pick still starts a new note. Less if held chords start again by themselves.
tips.prof_pct: Depth: 100 starts every note from nothing, less lets some of the pick through.

reverse.name: Reverse Delay
reverse.icon: <path d="M21 12H9m0 0 5-5m-5 5 5 5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="3.5" cy="12" r="1.6" fill="currentColor" opacity=".6"/>

tips.tiempo_ms: Time: how long each piece is that is played backwards.
tips.realim_pct: Feedback: more repeats. Every second one is the right way round again.
tips.mezcla_pct: Mix: up to 50 the backward sound comes in, from there the guitar goes out.
tips.amort_pct: Damping: takes the highs out of the backward sound.

tips.vel_chz: Rate: how fast the three voices waver.
tips.prof_pct: Depth: how far out of tune they go.
tips.tono_pct: Tone: from round to bright, for the voices.
tips.mezcla_pct: Mix: up to 50 the voices come in, from there the guitar goes out.

vintage.name: Vintage Delay
vintage.icon: <path d="M9.4 12a3.4 3.4 0 1 1-6.8 0 3.4 3.4 0 0 1 6.8 0z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M16.4 12a2.4 2.4 0 1 1-4.8 0 2.4 2.4 0 0 1 4.8 0z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" opacity=".75"/><path d="M21.9 12a1.5 1.5 0 1 1-3 0 1.5 1.5 0 0 1 3 0z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".5"/>

tips.tiempo_ms: Time: when the first repeat comes. While it is turned the pitch bends.
tips.realim_pct: Feedback: more repeats. At 100 they go on, darker and darker.
tips.mezcla_pct: Mix: up to 50 the repeats come in, from there the guitar goes out.
tips.amort_pct: Damping: how dark the repeats are, and how much darker each is than the one before.
tips.prof_pct: Depth: a slow waver of the repeats, as of an old tape.

glide.name: Pitch Glide
glide.icon: <path d="M3 18.5c7.500 0 9-12.500 17-12.500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.200" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M15.600 3.800 20.400 6l-2.300 4.700" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

tips.interval: Interval: where the voice goes at full bend, up to two octaves up or down.
tips.bend_pct: Bend: how far along the way the voice is, 0 being the note that is played. A footswitch's ramp or a MIDI controller moves it.
tips.mezcla_pct: Mix: 100 is the voice alone, so the bend is all that is heard. Lower, the guitar plays beside it, and at rest only the guitar is heard.
